title: Podkletnov's gravity shielding and a Schauberger/Soviet lineage

tellings.quote:

University of Tampir in Finland who

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, tells of a researcher named Eugene Podkletnov at the University of Tampere in Finland who, in the 1990s, claimed that objects weighed less when placed above spinning superconductors, materials that carry electricity with no resistance. Michels ties this to earlier work by a man named Viktor Schauberger and to Soviet research, drawing on a book by Nick Cook called The Hunt for Zero Point. If true, it would mean people have found a way to partly block gravity.
